notes.title: Handsome Hats are coming!
notes.content:
Hello Super Adventurers!

Firstly thank you for being a part of this handtastic community. Your feedback has really helped continue to develop Super Adventure Hand.

I wanted to tease a new update coming soon with some new customisations to express yourself even more. I’m calling it the Handsome Hats Update. Yes, whether you want a spooky Jack-O-Lantern, some bunny ears or something else there will be something for you to enjoy soon!

notes.title: Super Adventure Hand it out!
notes.content:
So here we are! Launch day for our little hand friend and his fiendish feet enemies!

It’s been a fantastic journey to this point, coming up with loads of fun (and often silly) puzzles and things to do with the hand. Putting in all sorts of obstacles and items that can be used. When I started I didn’t imagine I would have made a little car to race around in for the hand but there we go, it made sense and it works. Most importantly it’s fun.

This isn’t the end though. I have some small plans for some new fun customisations. A handy hat anybody?

[previewyoutube=sdEfHX8yCx4;full][/previewyoutube]

It’s been almost two years since I started working on this handy little game, feels great to finally have it out there!

[b]Now on to adventure, a Super Adventure infact![/b]

notes.title: How the intro was HAND made!
notes.content:
That’s right! This week I wanted to share with you some behind the scenes of how the animated intro was HANDled from inception to completion by the fantastic folks at Brikk! The original idea came about when thinking ‘why’. Why is the hand armless and what is its motivation. I quickly realised that getting the arm back was a priority and so this meant I had an idea for the intro.



[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42445631/3aded773918744c677ad8c4059c23e32f417c8f1.png[/img]

Above you can see my original story board that I wanted to share with potential partners who could help me make it a reality. I did consider if it could be done in-game/engine but quickly realised this needed to be something very special and to do it in-game would take too much of my time that I wanted to devote to making a fantastic game experience.



[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42445631/41222ffd6b580d25676fc5ce04d59ccec9ebeb41.png[/img]

I was introduced to Brikk and we had a great conversation about what I envisaged and they loved the idea. Here is work in progress as they blocked out the intro from my original story board. What also liked with working with Brikk was their ideas of injecting the same sort of humor that I wanted in Super Adventure Hand.




[previewyoutube=7AVEaX-nHe8;full][/previewyoutube]
And as you can see they really did a fantastic job and I HANDS down love it! I hope you enjoyed this little bit of behind the scenes information and I will think of some more things to share over the summer. If you haven’t seen the intro, why don’t you give the latest version of the demo a whirl and check it out there!



[h3]Until next week. Stay HANDsome! ✋[/h3]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42445631/e4f5dbac826b373c67cbb6ae0a91e890142b193f.gif[/img]

notes.title: Experimenting with new controls? Gripping stuff!
notes.content:
This last week has been a very productive one. Firstly, the last of the levels has been completed so now I will be focusing on continuing to tweak and improve on them going forward. As usual I’ve been tracking down bugs, issues and looking to optimize the game so that it will run as smoothly as though it had been lathered in hand cream!

I have received a lot of valuable feedback with the demo being up for a while now and one thing that was repeated several times was to do with camera issues. Some people really don’t like it when the camera rotates by itself. :)
To combat this I’ve been experimenting with an alternative control scheme, it loses some precision when it comes to smaller movements but it’s closer to what you’d expect from a traditional third person camera/controls.
The initial feedback has been positive, players who found some jumping sections or wall crawling tricky, are now finding it much easier.

I am planning on updating the demo soon with this new control scheme as an option so you’ll be able to try it first hand! Just as soon as I’m able to lay my hands on the latest localization pass.

Stay HANDsome! :D


[previewyoutube=mUshtNww6Ms;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Another handful of levels!
notes.content:
That’s right. I’ve been hard at work creating some exciting new levels and I’m getting close to the final one. In fact next week I will be working on the last planned level for the game.

I’ve also been HANDling lots of tricky bugs and tweaks to make Super Adventure Hand even better. In addition, I’ve been working on the achievements. Lastly, this week has been focused on localization because I want to make sure lots of players can enjoy Super Adventure Hand in their preferred language. There was a professional localization pass for the February demo, but the text added since then has temporarily been using Google translate which obviously isn’t great.

notes.title: New levels where you can have a trashing good time!
notes.content:
Wow! What a week we had last week! It was great to be part of the Guerrilla Collective and share the brand-new trailer and never before seen cinematic game intro. I will be sharing some more behind-the-scenes on how that trailer was made in the future so stay tuned for that!

Releasing a new trailer, updated demo and being part of a cool collective wasn’t the only thing I did last week though. I created some more levels including one that utilises garbage bags… yes I literally put garbage bags into the game and they make for a fun and tricky piece to the puzzle.

I also had some fantastic feedback on the new demo level but am always looking for more feedback so don’t be shy!

notes.title: Development update - Guerrilla Collective
notes.content:
Continuing on my plan to do more regular updates here is this weeks and it’s an exciting one. 
I’ve been busy working on my levels, tweaking old ones and optimizing Super Adventure Hand further.

The exciting part is that late on Wednesday / Thursday (depending on where you are) I will be releasing a new updated demo. This will have lots of new tweaks, fixes, squashed bugs and a brand new level to play! 
There is also one other addition but I won’t spoil the surprise, you’ll just have to check it out and let me know what you think!

Super Adventure Hand will also make an appearance at the Guerrilla Collective so tune into the stream to check it out on Wednesday!

notes.title: Development update
notes.content:
I’m going to try and do more regular updates on things I’ve been working on so here goes!
This last week I spent a large chunk of time creating some new levels. I managed to make 5 more which have all come together nicely. They offer various different challenges and I promise I’ve not been too devious!

To tease you a little I can reveal that in these levels there is more fire, pipes, keys (of course) some little ones and plenty of opportunities to use your brains (well hand brains). I’ve also found an opportunity to reuse some other aspects of some previous levels in new and interesting ways.
There is some exciting stuff coming which I can’t say much about yet but be prepared to see some new things in early June!

notes.title: The Tiny Electrician
notes.content:
Lately I’ve been adding a lot of new mechanics to the game, one that stands out and that I personally really like are the cables.
You, through your handy Hand, drag them around and plug them into sockets, enabling things like levers, elevators, ziplines and other things. There’s both a pizzle element to this and just wobbly physics fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42445631/ec7a5d1ba8a4db9130f6e983ecc24a45983e5906.gif[/img]

Longer clip of the first cable level.
[previewyoutube=5zPTWTs386I;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Feet now have eyebrows! (and other news)
notes.content:
By now you’ve probably figured out that the game is about a Hand. The handsome, funny, helpful and (mostly) handy HAND.
But there wouldn’t be much of a game if everything was happy and problem-free, so who would be the hands' natural enemy? Well, the answer is simple, feet of course!

Originally the feet were just ordinary, eye-less feet. But one late night I smacked on some googly eyes as a joke, and it just looked way too funny to be without, I just had to keep the eyes.
I considered adding eyes to the hand too, but it looked really weird, and the hand is mostly facing(handing) away from the camera so it doesn’t have the same impact anyway.

The eyes made the feet look kinda friendly though, I was ok with that but it kept bothering me slightly. But then, much later, the idea popped up, add eyebrows, that should make them look more sinister. Said and done, now the feet have eyebrows. 
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42445631/47ee0e5ac9b08a05f75b52bf1f9ca429275398c3.png[/img]


Something that is easy to miss, and not very visible in the trailers (since I’m just that good at the game! ;) ) is that the Hand gets a new band-aid each time it respawns, it's a fun little detail that still adds a lot to the game I think. Especially when you reach the end of a difficult level with band-aids all over the Hand. :D
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42445631/ee153c74cde33f4e2df3f956a5863d3e8b137dd9.png[/img]


And now for something unrelated to body parts, I’m also working on a proper level for the car, the previous level was more a tech demo than a fun level. Here’s a quick gif of that. :)
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42445631/e2f4ed5259567ebc4d4d68d2714a4c72c0642969.gif[/img]


Last but not least, Super Adventure Hand is taking part of the MIX Showcase starting today, check out your favorite hand game and other cool stuff at: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TheMIXMarch2023]The MIX March 2023[/url]

notes.title: Try the demo now!
notes.content:
The demo is out now, give it a try! It was actually released last week since I wanted to gather some feedback before diving straight into the Steam Next Fest.

The speedrunning community have dug their fingers into the demo, and are fighting for the top spots in the leaderboards. Already seeing some really amazing times and some speedrunning techniques I did not think was possible. :)
It’s not a bug if it makes the game more fun, right?

There’s also a Discord setup for the game now, join it here: [url=https://discord.gg/32zfwrCRXg]https://discord.gg/32zfwrCRXg[/url]

While all that is happening there’s a lot of new features, levels and other content being made for the full game. I’m planning to release it in Q3 but there's no exact date yet.
